title: top-up: merge queue availability, opt-out, merge_group coverage, queued-base lookup, removal reader and check id
definition: Reviewed the six merge queue modules (Issue #4424). Availability is read from repository and organisation metadata; where that is inconclusive, a disabled probe ruleset carrying a merge_queue rule is created and deleted, straight after creation, and a failed delete is reported with the leftover named. A read-only run never probes and reports unknown. The opt-out topic is read, and an unreadable topic list is an error rather than not opted out. The merge_group coverage check reads the workflows that report required checks and fails closed: anything it cannot establish is unknown, never ok. The queued-base lookup is memoised for ten minutes, never memoises a failed read, and treats null as not queued. The queue-removal reader binds a removal to the current head and collapses its reason to one line capped at 200 characters. The synthetic check id is a fixed prefix plus the leading characters of the head sha. Inputs from GitHub are validated before use, and repository text is parsed as data and never executed.
